transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Good morning team, let's start our Sprint 14 sync. First up, Alex, what is the status of Task 2?

transcript.speaker: Alex
transcript.text: Task 2 is progressing well. I finished the OAuth token generation and the PR was merged yesterday.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Great, let's make sure we update Jira KAN-2 to In Review or Done.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: What about Task 1, the core user authentication workflow?

transcript.speaker: Alex
transcript.text: Task 1 is completely done on my end! The login API is fully finished and ready for production.

transcript.speaker: Elena
transcript.text: Wait Alex, I looked at GitHub this morning. PR #45 for the login API is still open with 3 failing unit tests.

transcript.speaker: Alex
transcript.text: Ah right, the PR isn't merged yet. My local tests passed, but CI failed on the token expiration checks.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Okay, so Task 1 is NOT done yet. We keep KAN-1 in In Progress until that PR is actually merged.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Next decision: how should we handle session token expiry?

transcript.speaker: Alex
transcript.text: I propose we use 15-minute access tokens with refresh token rotation. It's the most secure standard.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Agreed. Let's officially decide on 15-minute access tokens with refresh token rotation.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: David, what are your action items for the frontend?

transcript.speaker: David
transcript.text: I will complete the responsive review dashboard components by tomorrow Friday.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Awesome. Also, we noticed someone needs to configure the Redis staging cluster.

transcript.speaker: Elena
transcript.text: I can take that if needed, but someone also needs to draft the API documentation before end of week.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Yes, we need API documentation written, but we didn't assign who owns it yet. Let's flag that.

transcript.speaker: Elena
transcript.text: One major risk: our cloud provider announced scheduled maintenance on the EU database cluster next Tuesday.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: That is a high severity risk. Elena, please monitor that and prepare a failover plan.

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: Hey everyone, quick question. Can we also integrate Apple Pay and cryptocurrency checkout into this sprint?

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Mark, crypto and Apple Pay checkout are definitely not in our agreed project scope. We will need to log that as a formal scope change request.
